```{python}
with open("../../homework/hw5/hw5_raw.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    fin_lines = f.readlines()
clean_text = "".join(fin_lines)
fin_text = re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', '', clean_text)
```
```{python}
songs = re.split(r"\*[^*]*\*", fin_text)
songs = songs[1:]
```
```{python}
verses = re.split(r'\[.*?\]', clean_text)
verses = verses[1:]
```
```{python}
rows = []
songs_num = 0

for song in songs:
    songs_num += 1
    verses_num = 0
    for verse in verses:
        verses_num += 1
    lines = re.split(r"[\n]+", song.lower()) 
    lines = [l for l in lines if l != ""]
    for l in lines:
        rows.append({"line": l, "songs": songs_num, "verses": verses_num})

fin_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```
```{python}
length = fin_df["length"] = fin_df["line"].str.len()
```

